data.exact_reserve_text: Within the calendar year technical result, a deficit of GBP 5.2m (2016: surplus of GBP 0.8m) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Estimated actuarial liability of GBP 7.7m booked on the 2016 year of account for UK GAAP reporting at 31 December 2017 due to a licensing breach on a group life policy.

Potential future losses from a group life contract, reserved at a loss ratio of approximately 200% on a forecast ultimate premium, net of commissions, of GBP 8.9m split across the 2016 and 2017 years of account.
Syndicate 308 closed the 2015 year of account at a loss as several large claims were experienced on key binders.

named_events.loss_description: Estimated actuarial liability of GBP 7.7m booked on the 2016 year of account for UK GAAP reporting at 31 December 2017 due to a licensing breach on a group life policy.

Potential future losses from a group life contract covering investors in an investment scheme, reserved at a loss ratio of approximately 200% on a forecast ultimate premium, net of commissions, of GBP 8.9m split across the 2016 and 2017 years of account.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 308 experienced a net strengthening of GBP 5.2 million in its prior year reserves during 2017, primarily due to a reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years. This adverse development was influenced by specific issues such as an estimated actuarial liability of GBP 7.7 million related to a UNFCU policy licensing breach from 2016, and potential future losses of GBP 8.9 million from a group life contract, also impacting the 2016 year of account. Additionally, the 2015 year of account closed at a loss due to large claims on key binders.
raw_causal_phrases: a deficit of GBP 5.2m relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years
estimated actuarial liability of GBP 7.7m in relation to the UNFCU policy
potential future losses from a group life contract covering investors in a particular investment scheme
increase in claims frequency on key binders
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure is net of reinsurance as no gross figure was explicitly available. The claims development table on page 36 is not a cumulative incurred claims triangle and therefore could not be used for prior year development calculation.
